The change date must be stored after the fact, but a date field on the Contract would break the no-dates rule and OQ-144, so the audit route fits: the new Contract's contract.create entry carries replaces {contractId, fromISO} in its after (Phase 49's D94). One derived read each way feeds DM-02, DM-03 and DM-04. No PERSIST_VERSION bump. Phase 49, Lane A.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue text and prototype refs re-read and confirmed (lines 85, 158, 169, 201 match).

dataModelDeltas.title: Replace a Contract from a date, as one action
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: US-04.1.8: one action copies the Contract with any setting changed under a new AA code, moves the ticked Procedures dated on or after the change date, and leaves the old Contract Active (to-do) or disables it; authorised Lists are locked and left out.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Two separate acts: create a new Contract by hand, optionally naming a replaced one and a date, then a read-only list of Procedures still on the old one. Nothing copies the old Contract, moves a Procedure from the panel, or leaves or disables the old one as part of the act. setProcedureContract has no planner and runs its own mutate with side effects.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Needs DM-01. New office-only store action in one change set: create from the copy (planContractCreate + contractRefusal), move the ticked Procedures one audited change each, then leave or disable the old Contract (move first, then disable). Open points for the phase: moves are per-Procedure commits unless setProcedureContract is refactored; per-row refusal; whether event fees copy; a system Contract cannot be replaced. Phase 49, Lane A.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Refs re-checked against master; Phase 49 doc covers it.

dataModelDeltas.title: A Contract still Active after its replacement date is a to-do item
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: US-04.1.8: on the change date a to-do reminds the office to disable the old Contract. FT-13.7 and US-13.7.2: the dashboard to-do list.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: The to-do list has two row kinds, both keyed to a Booking (open warnings, Bookings with no Contract). Warnings take one Booking as subject (Warning carries a bookingId); no row concerns a Contract and none depends on a date passing.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Needs DM-01. A third ToDoItem kind whose subject is a Contract, derived (not stored) from the replacement link when the date is reached and the old Contract is still Active; follows the noContract row pattern (no Clear). Needs an ordering rule for a row with no session and a way for the rail card to open a Contract. Whether a re-enabled Contract brings the row back is unstated (a derived row would). Phase 49's D94 words the to-do as a rule in domain/warnings/rules/, but a Warning is Booking-keyed, so the phase must either widen the finding's subject to a Contract or use the derived ToDoItem kind. Phase 49, Lane A.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Added the D94 tension: the phase doc calls it a warning rule, while the Warning type (types.ts:114) is keyed to a Booking.

dataModelDeltas.title: Disabling is confirmed and lists the Procedures first (replaced case remains)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: US-04.1.2 criterion 'Disable confirmed': Disable asks first and lists the Procedures still on the Contract. US-04.1.8 'Late disable': a replaced Contract disabled after the change date lists from the change date.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Built on master in Phase 45: ContractDisable opens a danger ConfirmSheet that lists the Procedures from disableFromISO before anything changes. disableFromISO returns today. Not built: listing from an earlier replacement change date, and the disable-as-replaced path.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Narrowed since the earlier run. Only disableFromISO widens once DM-01's read exists (Phase 49 item 8); no store invariant changes. The confirm list is the same read the replace action shows (DM-02). Needs DM-01 for the replaced case only.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: disableFromISO at contractChangeSelectors.ts:48 still returns today; confirm sheet is on master.

dataModelDeltas.title: An anaesthetist has a last day, from which they are inactive
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: US-12.1.6 (new) and the domain model rule: the office sets a last day with a reason; refused while the anaesthetist holds a List after it; until then nothing changes; after it no Slots and not offered or picked for any List (assignment or availability finder); the day can be cleared before it comes; made active again gives Slots from that day; each action audited. US-01.1.1 links 'active'.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A single boolean Anaesthetist.active flipped by the editor's Status control, acting at once: Slots removed from today, refused while Lists exist from today. No last day, no reason, no future date, no clearing; audited only as an ordinary update. The flag is read as 'usable now' in about fifteen to twenty places (slot picker, AA fee preview, list and booking moves, draft assignment, canvas generator, clock roll, pairing picker, matching open-slot read, rebook candidates, list-move demo, demo invariant), and the unmatched-receipt check refuses a payment naming an inactive anaesthetist. Recurring bookings read Slot existence, not the flag. startDateISO already exists, so active-from-start-date needs no change. No seeded anaesthetist is inactive.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Must precede DM-06 and DM-07. Add last day and reason to the anaesthetist; activity becomes a function of a date, so every reader moves to one pure isActiveOn(anaesthetist, dateISO). Canvas generation, roll-forward and anaesthetistCanvasDelta take the last day as an end; the guard becomes 'a List after the last day' and returns those Lists; three audited actions (set, clear, make active again). A stored mirror flag would need a dayAdvanced hook; a derived one needs none. Open: the AA fee run for the month someone leaves keys on the flag; a payment received after the last day for earlier work would be refused by paymentActions.ts:294 and must not be (key it on existence or the work's date); a demo needs an inactive anaesthetist or a trigger. Touches no Contracts-lane file (editor and record are EditAnaesthetistSheet and AnaesthetistRecord); a seeded inactive anaesthetist bumps PERSIST_VERSION (second to join renumbers). Lane C candidate in Wave 1.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue and core claim upheld. Corrected the reader list (recurring bookings do not read the flag), added readers, and added the payment-receipt guard conflict with 'everything recorded before stays'.

dataModelDeltas.title: An inactive anaesthetist's own Contracts are disabled, and offered back
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: US-04.1.2 criterion 'Inactive anaesthetist' and US-12.1.6: once the last day has passed the Contracts held by the anaesthetist's own Party and linked to them are Disabled; made active again, they are offered back to the office ticked and showing their price, and the ticked ones become Active.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing connects an anaesthetist's status to a Contract's. disableContract and enableContract exist and are audited. The seed has the story's example (Beaumont Rhinoplasty, held by PARTY.beaumont, linked to her). A Party of kind anaesthetist has no link to the anaesthetist record (matched by name only; Party has hospitalId but no anaesthetistId), so 'own Party' has no stored meaning.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Needs DM-05. A rule, not a new record: on the last day passing, disable Contracts whose holder is an anaesthetist-kind Party and whose linkedAnaesthetistId is the person (system, audited, via the existing planner); on reactivation show them ticked and enable the confirmed ones. Phase choices: find 'own Party' by derivation (no new field, matches the domain model) or a stored Party.anaesthetistId (bump, backfill; addAnaesthetist creates no Party); offer back all disabled or only those disabled by inactivity (the audit can tell); when the disable happens (a dayAdvanced subscriber vs at set time). The date stays on the anaesthetist, so no-dates and OQ-144 are untouched. Use a new store file calling the existing actions; do not edit contractActions.ts or contractHistory.ts while Lane A holds them.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Party shape (parties.ts:44-75) has no anaesthetistId; seed example confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: No sign-in after the last day
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: US-13.5.3 criterion 'Inactive': sign-in succeeds on the last day and is refused the day after; an anaesthetist made active again can sign in again. OQ-147 (open) asks how a departed anaesthetist sees later remittances.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Sign-in is a per-device browser session ({signedIn, account} in localStorage) that imports nothing from the store; the one demo account is Dr Souter's and any other email is refused and audited. Nothing consults the anaesthetist's status, and a stored session survives reloads and clock changes.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Needs DM-05. Apply 'the account's anaesthetist is active today' at the sign-in attempt (refused with its own reason in the auth.signInFailed audit) and at the gate that keeps a stored session so a signed-in handset is signed out once the clock passes the last day. The session store stays pure. The rule shows in the demo only if Dr Souter is the one made inactive or the demo account becomes selectable. No stored state. Built to the default of OQ-147 (sign-in stops entirely).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Session file and sign-in screen re-read; no status check exists.

dataModelDeltas.title: The surgeon group record is removed; the Party of kind surgeon group stays
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: US-13.4.1 criterion 'No surgeon group record' and US-13.6.2: there is no surgeon group list to keep; a surgeon belongs to no group; a group that holds Contracts is a Party and its surgeons are those linked on its Contracts. Domain model: a surgeon group exists only as a Party. OQ-148 (open) asks whether AA needs any list of who practises together.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A SurgeonGroup master (name, description, memberSurgeonIds, retired fields) in masters.surgeonGroups with two seeded groups; create, edit and retire actions; a retire kind, id prefix SGN, activeGroups selector and groupsForSurgeon; a Master data view and sheet; a Groups card on the surgeon profile; audit labels. Nothing in billing, the step rail, pairings or rules reads the members (checked by grep: only screens, groupsForSurgeon and the retire plumbing). A group rename carries the same-named Party along by name (partyRenameFollowing). The surgeon-group Parties and the Parties loader kind are the Party kind and stay.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Independent of the other deltas, but one unit: the type cannot go while a screen reads it, and the screens sit on masterViews.ts, view.ts and MasterData.tsx which Phase 48 edits, so it runs after the Contracts lanes join (the later wave with the section move). Remove the type, the masters slice and seed, the three actions and the retire/rename plumbing, the Master data view and catalogue rows, the Groups card, audit labels, and the tests and parity baselines naming them. Requires a PERSIST_VERSION bump (persisted state carries the slice). Party and Contracts held by a surgeon-group Party are untouched.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Grep for memberSurgeonIds and groupsForSurgeon confirms no billing or rule reader.

dataModelDeltas.title: The rate and the priority tier are one card and one audited change
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: US-12.1.4: the rate per unit and the priority tier sit on one card; each save is one audited change. US-01.3.6: the tier is changed with Edit then Save (Cancel leaves it), never by a single click.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Two records written by two actions: Anaesthetist.unitValue via editAnaesthetist (one anaesthetist.update) and the tier as a row of officePrivate.priorityTiers via setPriorityTier (its own anaesthetist.tierSet). The record page shows the tier as a sliding control that saves on every click, apart from the Profile card holding the rate.
dataModelDeltas.impact: No new data. A card saving both would write two commits and two audit entries unless joined; withChangeSet already makes several entries one change set, matching the codebase's 'a save is one change set'. The tier stays in the office-private slice. Changing only one writes only that one; the click-to-save control becomes Edit, Save and Cancel. Touches AnaesthetistRecord.tsx and EditAnaesthetistSheet.tsx, neither a Contracts-lane file; the later page rebuild uses ProfileChrome. Lane C candidate (the tier in a card).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Confirmed the tier saves on each click (AnaesthetistRecord.tsx) and setPriorityTier is its own audited mutate.

dataModelDeltas.title: A patient needing the office is one row with its reasons
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: US-11.3.3: Needs follow-up is one list of every patient needing the office (a balance warning, a follow-up due, details that differ), the reason on each row, a patient with several reasons appearing once; its count is the People attention count. US-11.1.5: rows waiting for an NHI are shown on Intake and counted in Intake's attention count.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: The follow-up view is three separate tables (balance warnings, follow-ups due, details to review) plus a Waiting NHI tab, and the nav count sums four lists. The count is of rows, not patients: a patient with two reasons counts twice, and so does one with two open balance warnings (one per Booking) or two due reminders (openBalanceWarnings and followUpsDue are per warning and per reminder; only patientsWithPendingDetails is per patient). Waiting NHI rows are already open intake rows (derived), which Intake's attention count already includes, so they are counted in both badges today.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A derived read patientsNeedingOffice(state): one row per patient with its set of reasons and the count of those patients, replacing the three-table split and four-way sum (grouping balance warnings and reminders by patient); waiting NHI rows leave the patient count and stay in Intake's. No stored change. The Needs follow-up filter and People badge (AdminApp.tsx) belong to the section-move wave. The new Intake tab for waiting rows is a Lane C candidate, but Intake's tabs are routes (routes.tsx, router.tsx), so it adds one route in files the Contracts lanes edit: keep it to one added entry and expect a small merge at the join.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Count is by row (per warning, per reminder), so even a single reason can repeat; the new read must group by patient. The rest upheld.

deltaSummary: Ten deltas verified and none refuted or dropped. All catalogue claims were re-read at 67cba2ce and are in scope, none retired and none in Future Work. Upheld: DM-01, DM-02, DM-04, DM-06, DM-07, DM-08 and DM-09. Corrected: DM-03, DM-05 and DM-10. In DM-03, Phase 49's D94 calls the to-do a warning rule, but a Warning is keyed to a Booking, so the phase must either widen the finding's subject to a Contract or use the derived ToDoItem kind. In DM-05, recurring bookings read Slot existence rather than the active flag, and more flag readers exist: matching open-slot, rebook candidates, list-move demo. The start date already exists. paymentActions.ts:294 refuses a receipt naming an inactive anaesthetist, which conflicts with "everything recorded before stays". In DM-10, the follow-up and attention counts are by row (per warning, per reminder), so even a single reason can repeat. Nothing was added: People-page keys, side panels, filters, patient pending details and the waiting-NHI move need no model change. domain-model-delta.md is updated with the corrections and an adversarial-verification note.
